children: RHB Bank's current share price may be fairly reflecting its fundamentals, with the bank's 5.4% 2026 dividend yield below its historical level, Kenanga IB analyst Peter Kong says in a note. RHB plans to announce a capital-management framework in 1Q to balance growth and shareholder distributions, he notes. Kong hasn't factored in potential higher dividends, as RHB might need to retain capital to support loan growth while maintaining ROE at around 10%. Kenanga maintains a market perform rating on RHB and keeps its target price at 8.40 ringgit. Shares are 4.4% lower at 8.30 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
